name: Luminous LUMI solar module installation robot
specialisedFor: utility-scale solar construction: lifting PV modules and placing them on tracker racking
summary: Tracked mobile manipulator from Boston that picks up solar modules, front or back, and places them on the racking so the crew only has to fasten them. A fleet trialled on the Goorambat East solar farm in Australia in 2025 with ARENA funding.

germany.statusNote: No German or European route found. Luminous works in the US and Australia, where it set up a local entity and warehouse for assembly and testing.

specs.label: Module weight handled
specs.conditions: 80 lb panels named by the maker
specs.quote: can help existing workforces to install 80 lb. (36.2 kg) solar panels up to 3.5 times faster

specs.label: Claimed speed-up
specs.value: up to 3.5 times faster than manual installation
specs.quote: install 80 lb. (36.2 kg) solar panels up to 3.5 times faster, without any heavy lifting or workflow changes

specs.label: Chassis
specs.value: tracked, with a larger battery than the first wheeled version
specs.quote: The startup soon moved from wheels to a tracked iteration with a larger battery.

specs.label: Pick-up
specs.value: picks modules from front or back
specs.quote: No other robot can pick up solar panels from front or back

specs.label: Claimed lifetime cost reduction
specs.conditions: maker estimate for solar farm costs over their lifetime
specs.quote: could reduce solar farm costs by up to 6.2% over their lifetime

notes: Arm and chassis are bought from partners; Luminous assembles and tests in Boston.
Workers still secure the modules on the racking after LUMI places them.
Version 4 is in limited production (CEO, July 2025).

evidence.task: Fleet of LUMI S4 robots placed solar modules on the racking during construction of a solar farm with almost 500,000 panels
evidence.where: Goorambat East Solar Farm (ENGIE), near Benalla, Victoria, Australia
evidence.note: With Bouygues Construction Australia and Equans; ARENA-funded. Luminous says the robots exceeded the target production rate.

evidence.task: First field test of the PV panel installer

sources.title: Luminous gets funding to bring LUMI solar construction robot to Australia (2 July 2025)
Autonomous robot module installation trial fast tracks Victorian solar farm (3 October 2025)
